hero.subtitle: Software Developer & AI Automation Engineer. I design backend architectures, deploy multi-agent systems and build automation pipelines that scale.

about.title: About me
about.p1: My specialty is backend architecture and the implementation of robust solutions to process high-volume data flows, ensuring seamless connectivity between enterprise-grade platforms.
about.p2: In recent years I've deepened my focus on multi-agent systems and intelligent task automation. I design and operate pipelines where orchestrator agents coordinate specialized sub-agents (Planner, Executor, Critic) to autonomously solve complex problems, with human-in-the-loop validation.
about.p3: I have hands-on experience with A2A (Agent-to-Agent) and Model Context Protocol (MCP), as well as LangChain, LangGraph, Kestra, n8n and cloud stacks (AWS, GCP) to deploy these solutions at scale.

skills.title: Tech stack
skills.subtitle: Tools and frameworks I use to design, build and orchestrate intelligent systems and high-performance automation.

bullets: Implemented core platform features, from initial idea to production, resolving complex bugs and ensuring stability.
Designed data pipelines for high-volume extraction and processing (PDF, Excel, CSV) and real-time flows.
Evolved the authentication system, migrating from JWT to a robust architecture with Zitadel.
Orchestrated ETL/ELT workflows with Kestra and implemented AI protocols (A2A, MCP) on AWS and GCP.
Designed and implemented automation pipelines with specialized sub-agents that reduce team manual tasks by 70%.

items.summary: Specialization in microservices and high-performance databases. Complex API integration and internal automation design.
Full-stack development focused on business logic, data security and process automation.
Technical consulting and bespoke solutions for international clients, including workflow automation.

projects.title: Featured projects
projects.subtitle: Open-source tools to boost security, productivity and orchestration.
projects.agronDesc: Lightweight Go library for AES-GCM authenticated encryption with pluggable key managers. Secure solution with no external dependencies for secrets management.
projects.blueprintDesc: CLI to generate complete REST APIs from simple definitions. Automates the creation of endpoints, Swagger documentation, tests and deployment configurations.
projects.apophisDesc: MCP server for OpenCode that orchestrates chaotic agents in parallel against a target: port scanning, web auditing, CVE matching against static + dynamic DB, sync from NVD/KEV/OSV/Exploit-DB and sandboxed PoC executor (L1/L2/L3).
projects.tonDesc: AI-First framework in Go that acts as an execution engine for Singularity (MCP). Zero Magic principles: minimal interfaces, typed errors, tools as primitives and isolated sandbox execution with CLONE_NEWNET.
